title: Per-op help: fix the COPY, add per-model specificity + imagery
description: MPI-360 shipped the mechanism, the dialog and the ? affordance - all accepted, all OUT OF SCOPE here. What is wrong is the TEXT. The agent authored every op's body/examples from docs and code reading, not from using the models, so entries are generically plausible rather than true. User has already spotted errors. This card is a content pass: correct the wrong claims, sharpen the vague ones, then add the per-model overrides and the media.
acceptance: Every authored help entry is reviewed against what the model ACTUALLY does - the user is the authority, not the docs the agent read. Wrong or hand-wavy claims are corrected or deleted; an op with no true thing to say falls back to its info one-liner rather than keeping filler
Examples are real prompts that were RUN, not invented ones that read well
help.byModel entries added wherever prompting genuinely differs - justified by a measured difference, never a guess. Not a full matrix
Media files under assets/help/ referenced from help.media; GIF renders via , mp4/webm/mov via the muted looping
The inpaint entry gains a trigger-word list ONLY if a model ships prompt-text routing (Klein MpiTextContains); until then the empty-prompt contract stays the whole story
No op regresses to an empty popup - getOpHelp's info fallback still covers anything unauthored
OUT OF SCOPE: the dialog component, the ? placement, the resolver. Those shipped and were accepted in MPI-360
